AccessKeyIn.description: A replacement access key, whole: a rotated key or a new SSO session changes every part.
AccessKeyIn.title: AccessKeyIn

CommandOut.description: A CloudFox loot command shown on this resource (ADR-0038). Argus never runs it.
CommandOut.title: CommandOut

CoverageOut.description:
Whether the scanner scans the resource, for one scan type. `active` is the verdict; the
status code and reason are the scanner's own words (AWS Inspector: ACTIVE or INACTIVE, with
a reason such as UNMANAGED_EC2_INSTANCE).
CoverageOut.title: CoverageOut

FindingDetail.description:
One finding with what the tool says about it: about the check, the same for each of its
findings (`detail`, about this resource, is in the list too).
FindingDetail.title: FindingDetail

FindingGroupOut.description: One check of the findings matching the filters (the Findings list by check).
FindingGroupOut.title: FindingGroupOut

FlowChip.description: What a node carries without being a step of the flow.
FlowChip.title: FlowChip

MapGroup.description: More neighbours of one kind than the map draws one by one: one node for all of them.
MapGroup.title: MapGroup

PathEdge.description:
One step with its evidence: how sure Argus is, why, and where it comes from ("rule
internet-entry@3", "CloudFox role-trusts", "manual").
PathEdge.title: PathEdge

PathEntryStep.description:
A path's first step, the internet to its entry: what the list says it gets in by (a
door's ports, a public policy, an outsider, a leaked credential).
PathEntryStep.title: PathEntryStep

RawStorageSettings.description:
Where AWS runs keep their raw output: an S3 bucket the operator owns, encrypted by its
default SSE-KMS key, with a folder per tool. Demo connections always use the local volume.
While no bucket is set, AWS runs cannot start: raw output of a real account never lands
on the unencrypted local volume (SA-8).
RawStorageSettings.title: RawStorageSettings

RemediationCode.description: Remediation a human may apply, as the tool wrote it. Argus never runs it.
RemediationCode.title: RemediationCode

RunTrigger.title: RunTrigger

ToolPrefixes.description: Each tool's folder in the bucket. The defaults are the design's layout, raw/<tool>.
ToolPrefixes.title: ToolPrefixes

ToolScans.description:
The newest day each tool's ingested run covers for the resource's connection; null
when the tool never scanned it ("Not covered" rather than "no findings").
ToolScans.title: ToolScans

VulnerabilityOut.description:
What a vulnerability finding adds (ADR-0042): the vulnerable package and its fix. A code
vulnerability has no CVE and no package.
VulnerabilityOut.title: VulnerabilityOut

VulnerabilitySection.description: The resource's vulnerabilities, as of the connection's last vulnerabilities run.
VulnerabilitySection.title: VulnerabilitySection

VulnerabilitySummary.description: A resource's open CVEs (ADR-0042), suppressed ones left out.
VulnerabilitySummary.title: VulnerabilitySummary

get.description: The Attack paths filters' options that come from the data.

put.description: The signed-in user's own password. Their other sessions end; this one stays.

get.description:
Every framework with results in the last six months: score, change, requirement counts
and a weekly trend, for one connection or all (0). `provider` repeats and matches the
framework's own provider.

One framework for one connection or all (0): its score, the history for the range, and
the six month-ends.

Each connection's month-end score for the framework, lowest latest score first. No
average row: the overall average across accounts was set aside (2026-10-07).

The framework's requirements on its latest day for the connection (or all, 0), by
section and requirement id.

schema.title: Response List Connections Api V1 Connections Get

get.description: The kinds the Add connection dialog may offer: no Demo on Kubernetes (ADR-0039).

schema.title: Response Connection Kinds Api V1 Connections Kinds Get

post.description:
Queues a test of an AWS connection (a Demo connection has nothing to test: 422). Asking
while one is open returns the open one.

get.description: The context bar: which accounts exist, and each tool's last run.
The options of the Findings filters that come from the data.

The Findings list by check, with the list's filters: one row per tool and check id,
worst severity first, then the checks with the most findings.

One finding, whatever its state, with what the tool says about it: what a finding's own
link opens, and the list's details row. Its scan time is `last_seen`.
Liveness: the process answers. No database call.
One flow as it stood on a day: its steps left to right, each node's chips and findings.

What faces the internet in one account: where the map starts. Open doors first, then
unknown, restricted and CloudFox's alone, each by name (ADR-0035); `reach`, `region` and
`q` narrow it.
Each door names the flow that starts from it (ADR-0036).
A group's members, by name, each with the edge that links it to the anchor.
The options of the Resources filters that come from the data.

post.description:
Cancels a queued run request (a waiting retry, a staggered scheduled run, a Run now). A
cancelled request is never retried. 404 when it is not queued: running runs are not
stopped from here.

get.description: Schedules by name; `q` keeps those whose name contains it, in any case.

post.description: Plain-language preview and next runs, before saving.

Queues a test of the platform identity: sign in, then write a marker to each tool's
folder of the raw output bucket.

Another user's password: they choose their own at the next sign-in. Your own is changed
with PUT /auth/password, which needs the current one.
